text: 今年以来，国家持续推动外贸“稳规模优结构”成效明显，外贸韧性持续增强。港口是外贸的晴雨表。7月，我国主要港口货运船舶离港载重量同比增长56.4%，增速比6月大幅提高38.9个百分点。
text_en: This year, the country's continued efforts to 'stabilize scale and optimize structure' in foreign trade have shown notable results, with foreign trade resilience continuing to strengthen. Ports are a barometer of foreign trade. In July, the total departure cargo tonnage of freight vessels at China's major ports rose 56.4% year-on-year, with growth accelerating sharply by 38.9 percentage points from June.
